create_group: create a new user group with name, description, and optional permissions using GroupTable.insert_new_group
query_groups: query groups by name filter, share scope, and member_id using GroupTable.get_groups
search_groups: search groups with pagination, name query, member filter, and share scope using GroupTable.search_groups
manage_group_members: add or remove users from a group by user_ids using GroupTable.add_users_to_group and remove_users_from_group
sync_user_groups: sync a user's group memberships to match a target list of group names using GroupTable.sync_groups_by_group_names
